trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully:

1. **Rolled back payments-api to v5.0.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). 2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("payments-api degraded after v5.1.0 deploy") — the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the service is registered as `payments-api`, not "payments," which is why I had to look it up by that name. I'd recommend verifying error rates have normalized now that the rollback has rolled out.
